1 دَوِىَ , (S, M, Msb, K,) aor. يَدْوَى, (Msb,) inf. n. دَوًى, He was, or became, diseased, disordered, distempered, sick, or ill: (S, M, Msb, K:) and he was, or became, affected with consumption, or ulceration of the lungs. (M.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] دَوِىَ صَدْرُهُ (assumed tropical:) His bosom was, or became, affected with rancour, malevolence, malice, or spite. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
